test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Please don’t ______ anyone that I came to your birthday party.
solution:
The correct answer is-'tell'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rule__**: We always use '**V1**' after '**don't**'.
 
• Now, let's check each option:
 __
 
• told: It is the **past** form of '**tell**'
 
• said: It is the past form of 'say'
 
• **tell**: to **give information to somebody** by **speaking or writing**
 
• say: to speak somebody something
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is 'tell'.
 
• Thus, *option 3 *is the correct answer.

 

The correct sentence is:* **Please don’t *tell__* anyone that I came to your birthday party.*
